bundles.name: Indulgence package
bundles.notes: Ultimate Beverage Package, Wi-Fi and unlimited specialty dining. Single source (Oct 2026).

bundles.name: All Included (Classic drinks + Basic Wi-Fi)
bundles.notes: Upcharge vs cruise-only is not published and varies by sailing, so the optimizer skips it until a price is known. Staff gratuities not included (beverage gratuities are). Default US fare type.

bundles.name: Have It All
bundles.notes: Signature Beverage Package (15 drinks/day up to $12), Surf Wi-Fi, specialty dinners: 1 (4-9 nights), 2 (10-20), 3 (21+); 1 is modeled. Excursion credit $100/$200/$300. $65/day for departures from summer 2027. Gratuities not stated as included.

bundles.name: Free at Sea (with most fares)
bundles.notes: Bundled into most fares as a promotion; you pay the $28.50/day drinks service charge. Specialty meal count varies by length (1 modeled). Renamed back from More at Sea in late 2026; the $50 excursion credit is no longer included.

bundles.name: Princess Plus
bundles.notes: 15 drinks/day up to $15 each, 1-device Wi-Fi, crew appreciation, 4 casual meals. $75 on Sun and Star Princess; +$5 if bought onboard.

bundles.name: Princess Premier
bundles.notes: Unlimited drinks up to $20, 4-device Wi-Fi, unlimited specialty dining, crew appreciation, excursion credit, photos. $110 on Sun and Star Princess.

lines.name: Azamara
lines.notes: Gratuities, house wines, beers, spirits and soft drinks included. Prime C and Aqualina about $50 each for non-suite guests. Basic Wi-Fi inclusion is disputed between sources.

lines.name: Carnival Cruise Line
lines.notes: CHEERS! $69.95 + 20% pre-cruise; Bottomless Bubbles $11.99 + 20%; Premium (streaming) Wi-Fi $25.50/day pre-cruise. Carnival moves drink and Wi-Fi packages to per-sailing pricing from 2026-12-01. Steakhouse about $52 incl. gratuity.

lines.name: Celebrity Cruises
lines.notes: Classic drinks ~$90 + 20% service (third-party, Sept 2026); Basic Wi-Fi ~$20/day; specialty dinners $58-67 + 20%. Soft-drink package price not found.

lines.name: Crystal
lines.notes: Butler for every guest; drinks, Wi-Fi and gratuities included. Umi Uma and Osteria d'Ovidio included with a reservation allotment (1 each up to 11 nights); unlimited for Penthouse guests.

lines.name: Cunard
lines.notes: Beverage Collection about $75-85.50/day depending on voyage length (third-party, 2026); Wi-Fi from $18/day. New 2026 Signature Packages (~$75/day) bundle drinks, Wi-Fi and dining credit; contents vary, not modeled.

lines.name: Disney Cruise Line
lines.notes: Fountain sodas included. No unlimited alcohol package is sold (drinks are bought individually). Recommended gratuities $16/person/night, $27.25 in Concierge. Wi-Fi and Palo/Remy prices not yet sourced.

lines.name: Explora Journeys
lines.notes: Drinks, Wi-Fi, gratuities and dining included; Anthology tasting menu is extra. Explora III (July 2026) not yet listed: capacity unconfirmed.

lines.name: Holland America Line
lines.notes: Signature Beverage Package from $54.95 + 18% (third-party, undated). Wi-Fi $30.99/day per Holland America's blog comparison. Pinnacle Grill about $52 (third-party).

lines.name: MSC Cruises
lines.notes: Premium Extra about $85/day pre-cruise incl. 18% service; Alcohol-Free about $30/day. Hotel service charge $17/day ($23 Yacht Club) for US-region bookings made from 2026-05-11 (was $16/$20). Bella/Fantastica/Aurea fare 'experiences' are not modeled as separate tiers.

lines.name: Norwegian Cruise Line
lines.notes: Most fares include Free at Sea (open bar, Wi-Fi, specialty meals); the drinks service charge is $28.50/person/day. Standalone package, Wi-Fi and specialty prices not yet sourced.

lines.name: Oceania Cruises
lines.notes: Fares include gratuities (since 2025), specialty restaurants, Wi-Fi and simply MORE (wine, beer and champagne at lunch and dinner, excursion credit) for the first two guests. Cocktails and spirits outside meals are extra (Prestige Select upgrade).

lines.name: Princess Cruises
lines.notes: Standalone Plus Beverage Package reported at $64.99/day incl. service charge (another source says $77.99). MedallionNet $24.99/day. Crown Grill about $55 + 20%.

lines.name: Regent Seven Seas Cruises
lines.notes: All-inclusive: drinks, Wi-Fi, specialty dining, gratuities and unlimited shore excursions are in the fare.

lines.name: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection
lines.notes: Drinks, Wi-Fi, gratuities and most dining included; signature restaurants or tasting menus may be extra (sources disagree).

lines.name: Royal Caribbean
lines.notes: Deluxe Beverage Package is priced per sailing (~$56-105 + 18% in 2026 reports); midpoint used. VOOM $16.99-30.99/device/day (official guide). Specialty: Chops $69.99, Giovanni's $54.99 (2024) + 18%.

lines.name: Seabourn
lines.notes: All-inclusive: drinks (most wines and spirits), Wi-Fi, gratuities and dining are in the fare, so add-on prices are not needed.

lines.name: Silversea
lines.notes: Butler in every suite; drinks, Wi-Fi and gratuities included (spa service charge extra). La Dame carries a surcharge. RCL shareholder credit coverage unconfirmed. Expedition ships out of scope.

lines.name: Viking (ocean)
lines.notes: Adults 18+. Fares include wine and beer with lunch and dinner, Wi-Fi, all restaurants and the LivNordic thermal spa. Silver Spirits all-day package about $27/night. Hotel and dining service charge $20/person/day from 2026-01-01 (discretionary). No shareholder perk found for VIK.

lines.name: Virgin Voyages
lines.notes: Adults 18+. All restaurants, sodas, drip coffee and basic Wi-Fi included. Gratuities unbundled for Sea Terrace and below from 2025-10-07: $20/day prepaid, $22 onboard. Premium fare option adds a $15/day bar tab (not modeled).

tiers.name: Suites
tiers.notes: Specialty restaurants complimentary; unlimited basic Starlink Wi-Fi (1 device per guest) from 2026-04-01.

tiers.name: Top suites
tiers.notes: Suite perks plus the Ultimate Beverage Package (premium drinks) from 2026-04-01.

tiers.name: Balcony
tiers.notes: Size/occupancy: About 185 sq ft plus a 35-75 sq ft balcony.

tiers.name: Cloud 9 Spa staterooms
tiers.notes: Unlimited thermal suite and thalassotherapy pool, priority spa booking. Sold as interior, ocean view, balcony and suite. Ship list from a truncated source; other ships may also have them.

tiers.name: Family Harbor staterooms
tiers.notes: Family Harbor Lounge with continental breakfast, snacks, games; kids 11 and under dine free at some venues. Size/occupancy: Family Harbor suites sleep 5.

tiers.name: Havana staterooms
tiers.notes: Private Havana pool area. All guests in the cabin must be 12 or older. Havana suites pay the suite gratuity ($19).

tiers.name: Suites (Junior, Grand, Ocean & Captain's)
tiers.notes: Priority check-in, boarding, luggage delivery, tender and debarkation. Size/occupancy: Ocean Suite about 275 sq ft plus 65 sq ft balcony.

tiers.name: Excel suites (Excel class only)
tiers.notes: Unlimited Loft 19 access (secluded top-deck area with pool and cabanas, priority cabana booking), dedicated concierge line, guaranteed specialty dining times. Reported extras: Bottomless Bubbles soda package and laundry; laundry terms unconfirmed. Size/occupancy: Excel suites about 398 sq ft up to the 1,120+ sq ft Presidential Suite (some figures include balcony).

tiers.name: Veranda (incl. Infinite Veranda)
tiers.notes: Edge-class Infinite Verandas: 131-184 sq ft plus 42-45 sq ft enclosed balcony area (TPG figures conflict).

tiers.name: Concierge Class
tiers.notes: Veranda layout + dedicated concierge, welcome lunch, priority dining/excursion support. Priority boarding: sources conflict (left unknown).

tiers.name: AquaClass
tiers.notes: Blu restaurant (AquaClass-exclusive), unlimited thermal suite (SEA Thermal Suite on Edge; Persian Garden on Solstice/Millennium), spa concierge. Size range varies by class.

tiers.name: The Retreat: Sky, Aqua Sky, Celebrity & Signature Suites
tiers.notes: Luminae (suite-only restaurant), Retreat Lounge (Michael's Club on Solstice/Eclipse/Reflection), butler, Premium drinks + Premium Wi-Fi. Laundry and unlimited specialty dining start at Royal Suite. Aqua Sky Suites also get thermal suite access. Retreat Sundeck not on Solstice, Eclipse, Reflection, Constellation, Infinity. Size/occupancy: Celebrity Suites sleep 4; AquaSky Suites 2.

tiers.name: The Retreat: Royal Suite & above (Royal, Penthouse, Edge Villa, Iconic)
tiers.notes: Adds unlimited specialty dining (dinner nightly, lunch on sea days), complimentary laundry + unlimited pressing, unlimited Premium drinks, personalized minibar, thermal suite. Edge Villa and Iconic Suite exist on Edge-class only. Size/occupancy: Penthouse Suites sleep 6, Royal Suites 4.

tiers.name: Deluxe Stateroom (window)
tiers.notes: Butler for every guest. Specialty restaurants included with an allotment (1 each up to 11 nights, 2 for 12-22, 3 for 23+).

tiers.name: Penthouse categories
tiers.notes: Unlimited Umi Uma and Osteria d'Ovidio. Complimentary laundry, pressing and dry cleaning reported for upper tiers (one source).

tiers.name: Britannia Balcony
tiers.notes: Size/occupancy: Plus a balcony of about 81 sq ft (Queen Mary 2).

tiers.name: Britannia Club
tiers.notes: Dedicated Britannia Club restaurant with single-seating dining. No Grills Lounge or Terrace. Size/occupancy: Sources range 248-470 sq ft.

tiers.name: Princess Grill suites
tiers.notes: Princess Grill restaurant (reserved table), Grills Lounge with afternoon tea, Grills Terrace. Priority boarding, concierge and laundry not confirmed (official Grills page unavailable when checked).

tiers.name: Queens Grill suites
tiers.notes: Queens Grill restaurant, Grills Lounge and Terrace, dedicated butler and steward, in-suite dining from the Queens Grill menu. Size/occupancy: Suites sleep up to 4.

tiers.name: Verandah
tiers.notes: Size/occupancy: Deluxe Family Verandah sleeps 5.

tiers.name: Concierge staterooms
tiers.notes: Concierge lounge with evening drinks, private sun deck (exclusive wading pool on Wish-class ships), priority boarding, early booking at 130 days. Wi-Fi for 24 hours only.

tiers.name: Concierge suites (1-bedroom and larger)
tiers.notes: Concierge perks plus Wi-Fi for the whole cruise. Size/occupancy: Sizes include the verandah. Royal Suites sleep 7-8.

tiers.name: Ocean Terrace & Ocean Grand Terrace Suites
tiers.notes: All-suite ship with in-suite dining; no dedicated butler in entry suites.

tiers.name: Penthouses
tiers.notes: Butler service from Penthouse up (sources disagree on the threshold).

tiers.name: Residences
tiers.notes: Butler service; higher suites reported to get unlimited laundry and pressing (unconfirmed).

tiers.name: Ocean-View
tiers.notes: Size/occupancy: Family Ocean View sleeps 5.

tiers.name: Vista & Signature Suites
tiers.notes: Official suite amenities list only a no-host mini-bar, binoculars and pillow choice; no concierge, laundry or priority access.

tiers.name: Neptune Suites
tiers.notes: Neptune Lounge with concierge, complimentary laundry, pressing and dry cleaning, priority check-in, disembarkation and tender boarding. Club Orange private dining only on Pinnacle-class ships; elsewhere priority dining-room seating. Size/occupancy: Neptune Spa Suites sleep 2.

tiers.name: Pinnacle Suites (Pinnacle class only)
tiers.notes: Neptune perks plus a larger suite with separate living area; Club Orange and Pinnacle Grill breakfast. Size/occupancy: Pinnacle Suite size includes the verandah.

tiers.name: Ocean View
tiers.notes: Size/occupancy: Family ocean-view cabins sleep up to 6.

tiers.name: Balcony
tiers.notes: Size/occupancy: Plus balcony. Family balconies sleep up to 6; connecting Super Family setups sleep more.

tiers.name: MSC Yacht Club
tiers.notes: Ship-within-a-ship: butler, concierge, Yacht Club restaurant, Top Sail Lounge, private sundeck and pool. One 2026 source says Premium Extra drinks are bundled in US fares; another prices it separately (unresolved). Not on Lirica or Musica class. Size/occupancy: Interior suites 180-226, Deluxe 269-305 (sleep 4), Royal 667-753 sq ft.

tiers.name: Club Balcony Suite
tiers.notes: One complimentary valet laundry, sparkling wine, treats twice per voyage, early dining booking. Ship list limited to Breakaway Plus and Prima-class ships; may exist on others.

tiers.name: Suites outside The Haven
tiers.notes: Core suite perks; butler and concierge vary by ship and category. Size/occupancy: Two-bedroom Family Suites sleep 6.

tiers.name: The Haven suites
tiers.notes: 24-hour butler and concierge, Haven courtyard pool and sundeck (16+), priority embarkation and tendering, Haven Restaurant on Breakaway, Breakaway Plus, Prima and Prima Plus ships. Complimentary laundry only for Owner's Suites and Garden Villas.

tiers.name: The Haven: Owner's Suites & Garden Villas
tiers.notes: Haven perks plus complimentary laundry (terms unconfirmed). Size/occupancy: Owner's Suites about 786-828 sq ft, sleep 4.

tiers.name: Inside
tiers.notes: Included wine and beer are served at lunch and dinner only.

tiers.name: Concierge Level Veranda
tiers.notes: Dedicated concierge, private Concierge Lounge, free laundry (up to 3 bags), room service from the Grand Dining Room. Aquamar Spa Terrace access on Vista and Allura.

tiers.name: Penthouse Suites
tiers.notes: Concierge Level perks plus 24-hour butler, suites-only Executive Lounge, priority luggage delivery. Spa Terrace access listed on Vista.

tiers.name: Oceania, Vista & Owner's Suites
tiers.notes: 24-hour butler, Executive Lounge, complimentary laundry up to 3 bags plus pressing on embarkation, priority luggage delivery. Size/occupancy: Oceania Suites 1,000+ sq ft; Vista Suites 1,450-1,850; Owner's Suites about 2,000.

tiers.name: Balcony
tiers.notes: Size/occupancy: About 181 sq ft plus 41 sq ft balcony (Discovery Princess).

tiers.name: Mini-Suite
tiers.notes: Size/occupancy: Some mini-suite figures include the balcony.

tiers.name: Reserve Collection mini-suites
tiers.notes: Reserve dining area with expedited seating, welcome wine, canapés on request, priority disembarkation. No lounge, no laundry. Size/occupancy: Reserve Collection mini-suites; some figures include the balcony.

tiers.name: Reserve Collection suites
tiers.notes: Reserve dining, Concierge Lounge, Suite Experience manager, complimentary laundry and professional cleaning (same-day express extra), mini-bar setup, private breakfast venue, priority disembarkation. Priority boarding not stated on the official page.

tiers.name: Sanctuary Collection (select suites and staterooms)
tiers.notes: Princess Premier is bundled in: premium drinks, unlimited specialty dining, Wi-Fi, crew appreciation, room service. Private spaces and Sanctuary Restaurant. Includes some non-suite staterooms. Sky and Enchanted Princess join in December 2026.

tiers.name: Veranda Suites (Deluxe & Superior)
tiers.notes: All-suite ship. Unlimited shore excursions included.

tiers.name: Concierge Suites
tiers.notes: Free one-night pre-cruise hotel, Wi-Fi for up to 4 devices, priority online reservations, 5% off Regent Choice excursions. No butler.

tiers.name: Penthouse Suites
tiers.notes: Butler service starts at Penthouse. Size/occupancy: Up to 644 sq ft including balcony.

tiers.name: Seven Seas, Grand, Master & Regent Suites
tiers.notes: Butler service and the largest suites; the Regent Suite adds private car and guide in port. Size/occupancy: Regent Suite up to 4,443 sq ft (Seven Seas Splendor).

tiers.name: Terrace Suites
tiers.notes: Every suite has a private terrace and butler service (one source).

tiers.name: Grand, View, Loft & Owner's Suites
tiers.notes: Two-level Loft Suites (about 667 sq ft) on Evrima.

tiers.name: Ocean View
tiers.notes: Ultra Spacious Ocean View (about 319 sq ft) sleeps up to 6.

tiers.name: Balcony
tiers.notes: About 182 sq ft plus about 50 sq ft balcony (Symphony). Size/occupancy: Royal Caribbean lists balcony rooms sleeping up to 8 (family balconies).

tiers.name: Sea Class: Junior Suites
tiers.notes: Priority boarding and a dedicated check-in line. Coastal Kitchen dinner only, by reservation and space permitting; no suite lounge. Coastal Kitchen exists on Oasis, Quantum and Icon class ships.

tiers.name: Sky Class: Grand, Owner's & Sky Loft suites
tiers.notes: Concierge, suite lounge with evening drinks, all-day Coastal Kitchen, suite sun deck (The Grove on Icon class). VOOM Wi-Fi for one device per person, except Sky Junior and Sunset Junior Suites. Drinks package and laundry not included.

tiers.name: Star Class: Royal Loft, Owner's Loft, Grand Loft, Ultimate Family & Villa suites
tiers.notes: Royal Genie service, Deluxe Beverage Package, VOOM Wi-Fi, specialty dining at most venues (some items extra), complimentary laundry and pressing, gratuities included (Genie tips extra). Royal Loft sleeps 6; the Ultimate Family Suite (Symphony, Wonder, Spectrum) may sleep more. Size/occupancy: Royal Caribbean lists suites sleeping up to 8-9 (Ultimate Family Suite); Royal Loft sleeps 6.

tiers.name: Veranda & Ocean View Suites
tiers.notes: All-suite ship; entry suites have a sitting area. One review says The Grill by Thomas Keller carries a cover charge; most sources say all dining is included.

tiers.name: Penthouse Suites
tiers.notes: Separate living and dining area; reported to add unlimited Stream Wi-Fi and a Nespresso machine.

tiers.name: Penthouse Spa Suites
tiers.notes: Access to the Spa Serene Area and a Spa Concierge.

tiers.name: Owner's, Signature & Wintergarden Suites
tiers.notes: Expanded in-suite bar and complimentary private car transfer (up to 50 miles); some have veranda whirlpools. Size/occupancy: Wintergarden about 1,200 sq ft.

tiers.name: Vista & Veranda Suites
tiers.notes: Butler included even in entry suites. La Dame has a surcharge; other venues included.

tiers.name: Grand & Owner's Suites
tiers.notes: Size/occupancy: Owner's Suites about 1,500 sq ft.

tiers.name: Veranda & Deluxe Veranda
tiers.notes: Wine and beer included with lunch and dinner only; Silver Spirits needed for all-day drinks. Thermal spa access included for all guests. Size/occupancy: About 224 sq ft plus 46 sq ft veranda (270 total on newer ships).

tiers.name: Penthouse Veranda
tiers.notes: Adds complimentary pressing and shoe shine. Size/occupancy: Plus 58 sq ft veranda.

tiers.name: Penthouse Junior Suite
tiers.notes: Complimentary laundry and dry cleaning. Size/occupancy: Plus 69 sq ft veranda.

tiers.name: Explorer Suite
tiers.notes: Complimentary laundry, pressing, dry cleaning and shoe shine; wraparound veranda. Size/occupancy: Plus 167-490 sq ft veranda (Viking Star); larger on newer ships.

tiers.name: Owner's Suite
tiers.notes: Explorer perks plus the Silver Spirits package and welcome champagne. Size/occupancy: Plus 156 sq ft veranda.

tiers.name: Sea Terrace
tiers.notes: Size/occupancy: Plus about 45 sq ft terrace.

tiers.name: RockStar Quarters
tiers.notes: Richard's Rooftop (suites-only lounge and deck), early VIP boarding, RockStar agent, bar tab credit. Whether gratuities are included is disputed between sources.

tiers.name: Mega RockStar Quarters
tiers.notes: Adds daily thermal suite access, pressed clothing service, private transfers and a larger bar tab (reported as bottomless; unverified).
